title: Through the lattice
alt: Terracotta lattice screens cast repeating shadows beside an olive tree and a reflecting pool.
description: Complex architectural layers, repeated geometry and carefully controlled light.
prompt: An extraordinary architectural photograph of a quiet courtyard enclosed by intricate perforated terracotta screens. Late-afternoon sunlight passes through the same geometric screens, casting delicate repeating diamond-and-star light patterns onto pale limestone paving and a shallow reflecting pool. The screens have consistent thickness and coherent structural supports. A single mature olive tree rises beside the pool, its trunk and branches reflected naturally in the still water. Refined modern architecture, warm earth, silver-green leaves and cool blue reflections, elaborate but physically readable shadows, beautifully controlled exposure, no people or text.
